silicon_bulk_modulus.name: Bulk Modulus of Silicon
silicon_bulk_modulus.description: Calculate the bulk modulus of silicon by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use reaxff potential and the given parameters for the simulation. Make sure to include charge equilibration using fix qeq/reaxff. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.
